column1: # Known outcomes of jasmin-checksafety, read by ci/jobs/safety.sh. The
# checker is the second safety check; every export's #[safety] contract is
# the lemmas it uses). A row says that the checker raises an alarm the
# proof refutes (FAIL), or gives no verdict within its limit (TIMEOUT), for
# that export of the units the pattern matches. One row per entry, four
#   unit      a shell pattern over the unit names
#   reason    what the checker reports or why it doesn't finish, and the
#             proved lemma that settles the contract
